name: showcase
title: Showcase: dashboard, server detail, studio, modpacks
docs: Showcase screenshot plan. Regen: boot a disposable seeded stack with scripts/review/devstack.sh up, then run node scripts/review/journey.mjs --plan scripts/review/plan-showcase.json --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> --out /tmp/showcase, then copy the showcase-*.png files to landing/assets/showcase/ and assets/showcase/. Re-run on UI changes to dashboard, server detail, studio, or modpacks. Credentials from PANEL_REVIEW_USER / PANEL_REVIEW_PASSWORD only; never commit PNGs you did not generate from a live stack.
